'''Link''' is a [[Effects|Potion Effect]] introduced by the Mod. This Effect can only be applied to parasites.

Parasites that have this effect will contribute to Global Adaptation without having to be close to a [[Colony]], if available.	

The number of potency multiplies the chance for Parasites to send their adaptations.
